title: Growing Tomatoes in Soil Blocks Indoors Part 1 Chaos In The Garden
reason: The video describes the process of growing tomato plants using soil blocks and offers tips on lighting, transplanting, and root growth encouragement.

tasks.task: Discuss the methods of growing tomato plants using soil blocks inside.

subtasks.text: Explain the initial setup of the grow lights using T12 fluorescent bulbs and LED strips.
Describe the process of letting tomato plants grow and selecting the healthiest ones for transplant.
Demonstrate the use of a soil block maker for transplanting tomato plants.

tasks.task: Provide guidance on when to transplant tomato seedlings into larger soil blocks or directly into a garden.

subtasks.text: Detail the signs to look for to determine when seedlings are ready for larger soil blocks, focusing on root growth.
Explain why flooding the tray helps encourage deep root growth in the soil blocks.
Offer tips for providing calcium to tomato plants through egg shell usage.
Explain the technique of burying tomato plants up to their first leaves to encourage root growth and plant stability.
